analyst_summary: Synthetic fixtures are not live market observations. The price frontier has no overlap and only 9 of 20 required mature paid samples, so wait on economic promotion. The supplied stockouts and repeat paid sales support a bounded stock-coverage operating intent; the shop discoverability block remains a constraint to diagnose, not a reason to assume restocking will succeed.
critic_summary: Synthetic fixtures only, not live market observations. Price-frontier evidence is insufficient for economic promotion: there is no overlap and 9 of 20 required mature paid samples. Stockouts and paid sales support a bounded stock-coverage response, subject to fresh-supply guards; the discoverability block may still prevent execution. Keep other parameters at baseline.
